figure: FIGURE 3.4 (Dense vs MoE parameter allocation and KV cache behavior)
issue: The right-column legend pairs each color swatch with a byte total that does NOT equal the sum of that color's boxes in the grid, breaking the visual-encoding rule the left column establishes (all-blue grid, blue swatch = 140 GB = all boxes). A reader who applies the left column's 'color = sum of that color's boxes' rule to the right column infers false values, and the caption is required to override the diagram.
evidence: Right grid draws 8 expert boxes: 2 orange (E1, E4) and 6 gray. Legend text: gray swatch = 'resident weights ≈ 94 GB'; orange swatch = 'per-token active-weight bytes ≈ 25.6 GB (12.8B × 2 bytes)'. Recomputation: 94 GB = 47B × 2 bytes = ALL 8 experts (gray + orange), not the 6 gray boxes (which would be ≈ 68 GB); 25.6 GB = 12.8B × 2 = 11.4B routed (the 2 orange boxes) + 1.4B always-on, and the always-on 1.4B has no box in the grid, so the 2 orange boxes are ≈ 22.8 GB, not 25.6 GB. Thus neither swatch value matches its colored boxes. The left column is internally consistent by contrast: 24 blue boxes, blue swatch = 140 GB = all 24 boxes. The two columns therefore use different, mutually inconsistent encoding rules, and the right one invites the false inferences '6 gray boxes = 94 GB' and '2 orange boxes = 25.6 GB'.
acceptance_test: Make the swatch-to-grid mapping explicit and self-consistent. Either (a) annotate the right grid as 'routed experts only; always-on 1.4B not drawn' and label the swatch values as category totals (resident = all 8 experts ≈ 94 GB; active read = 2 routed + always-on ≈ 25.6 GB), or (b) redraw the grid/legend so each color's boxes sum to its legend value. Pass condition: a reader applying the left column's 'color = sum of that color's boxes' rule to the right column must NOT obtain a number contradicting the caption (i.e., must not read the 6 gray boxes as 94 GB or the 2 orange boxes as 25.6 GB), and the always-on 1.4B component of the 25.6 GB must be visually accounted for or explicitly marked as not drawn.
